stem.text: River water in a chalky agricultural area contains $\text{Ca}^{2+}$, $\text{Mg}^{2+}$, $\text{CO}_3^{2-}$, $\text{HCO}_3^{-}$, $\text{Cl}^{-}$ and $\text{NO}_3^{-}$ ions. In a water treatment plant, such water is treated by adding a calculated quantity of calcium hydroxide.
What will be precipitated from the river water following the addition of calcium hydroxide?
